items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: people like Dizzy and Roy and Buck, you name it, all the great players around today, are dear friends of mine

ctx.x:
There is no doubt about it. Maybe with other players, and I say this with all due respect to them, maybe they sound a little old-fashioned, but Louis still sounds way ahead. There is no one, and I say this again with all due respect to Dizzy and Miles and all the great players, never had the beat that Louis had.

And again, I want to cover that by saying that I have -- that people like Dizzy and Roy and Buck, you name it, all the great players around today, are dear friends of mine and they know, they will vouch…
